notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.no_notifications_desc: Climate and market alerts will appear here when detected.

germination.heat_stress: Seedlings are very sensitive to heat. Provide shade if possible and water in early morning/evening.
germination.cold_stress: Young seedlings may die from cold exposure. Use mulch or row covers for protection.
germination.frost_risk: Frost can kill germinating seeds. Cover soil with straw or plastic sheets.
germination.waterlogging: Waterlogging at germination causes seed rot. Ensure proper drainage immediately.
germination.dry_spell: Seeds need consistent moisture for germination. Light frequent irrigation recommended.
germination.high_humidity: High humidity may cause damping-off disease. Avoid overwatering.

seedling.heat_stress: Transplant shock is worsened by heat. Consider temporary shade nets.
seedling.cold_stress: Protect seedlings from cold with mulch. Avoid night-time irrigation.
seedling.frost_risk: Cover seedlings with plastic tunnels or cloches overnight.
seedling.waterlogging: Seedling roots are shallow and can drown easily. Improve drainage.
seedling.dry_spell: Water stress stunts seedling growth. Maintain soil moisture.
seedling.high_humidity: Watch for fungal diseases. Ensure good air circulation between plants.

vegetative.heat_stress: Increase irrigation frequency. Plants transpire more in heat.
vegetative.cold_stress: Slow growth is normal in cold. Do not over-fertilize during cold spells.
vegetative.frost_risk: Vegetative growth can recover from light frost. Protect growing tips.
vegetative.waterlogging: Saturated soil reduces nutrient uptake. Apply foliar nutrition if needed.
vegetative.dry_spell: Critical period for leaf development. Deep watering every few days is better than light daily watering.
vegetative.high_humidity: Perfect conditions for foliar diseases. Consider preventive fungicide spray.

flowering.heat_stress: CRITICAL: Heat during flowering causes flower drop and poor fruit set. Irrigate frequently, consider shade nets.
flowering.cold_stress: Cold reduces pollinator activity. Hand pollination may help.
flowering.frost_risk: Frost kills flowers and young fruits. Protection is essential!
flowering.waterlogging: Excess water during flowering causes flower drop. Maintain light moisture only.
flowering.dry_spell: Water stress during flowering drastically reduces yield. Do not skip irrigation!
flowering.high_humidity: May affect pollen viability and promote flower diseases.

fruiting.heat_stress: Heat can cause fruit sunburn. Maintain leaf cover over fruits.
fruiting.cold_stress: Fruit development slows in cold. Extend harvest estimate accordingly.
fruiting.frost_risk: Frost damages developing fruits. Harvest early if frost is imminent.
fruiting.waterlogging: Can cause fruit cracking and rot. Ensure drainage.
fruiting.dry_spell: Fruit size is determined now. Consistent watering is critical.
fruiting.high_humidity: Watch for fruit rot diseases. Good ventilation helps.

maturity.heat_stress: Hot weather speeds up maturity. Prepare for earlier harvest.
maturity.cold_stress: May delay maturity. Monitor crop readiness carefully.
maturity.frost_risk: Harvest before frost if possible to avoid crop damage.
maturity.waterlogging: Stop irrigation before harvest for better quality.
maturity.dry_spell: Dry conditions at maturity are often beneficial. Reduces disease risk.
maturity.high_humidity: High humidity delays drying. May need post-harvest drying assistance.

nitrogen.negative: Low nitrogen availability limits plant growth and yield potential.
nitrogen.neutral: Nitrogen levels are not a major influencing factor for this crop.

phosphorus.positive: Phosphorus supports strong root development and early plant vigor.
phosphorus.negative: Insufficient phosphorus may restrict root growth and flowering.
phosphorus.neutral: Phosphorus levels are within a tolerable range for this crop.

potassium.positive: Potassium improves stress tolerance and overall crop resilience.
potassium.negative: Low potassium can reduce disease resistance and crop quality.
potassium.neutral: Potassium has a limited effect on this recommendation.

ph.positive: Soil pH is well suited for nutrient uptake and crop growth.
ph.negative: Soil pH may restrict nutrient availability for this crop.
ph.neutral: Soil pH does not strongly influence this crop's suitability.

rainfall.positive: Rainfall levels align well with this crop's water requirements.
rainfall.negative: Excess or insufficient rainfall reduces suitability for this crop.
rainfall.neutral: Rainfall does not significantly affect this recommendation.

temperature.positive: Temperature conditions are favorable for this crop's growth cycle.
temperature.negative: Temperature stress may negatively impact crop performance.
temperature.neutral: Temperature plays a minor role for this crop in current conditions.

timing_advice.very_high: Heavy rainfall detected. Delay fertilizer application by 2-3 days until soil drains. Apply in split doses to reduce leaching loss.
timing_advice.high: Above-optimal rainfall. Consider split application — apply half now and remaining after 3-4 days.
timing_advice.very_low: Very dry conditions. Apply fertilizer near irrigation channels or ensure irrigation within 24 hours of application for proper uptake.
timing_advice.low: Below-optimal moisture. Irrigate after fertilizer application or apply during early morning when soil has some dew.
timing_advice.optimal: Rainfall is optimal. Apply fertilizer as per standard practice.

basal_application.name: Basal Application
basal_application.description: Mixing fertilizer into soil before sowing or transplanting
basal_application.when_to_use: Before planting — apply during land preparation

manual_spread.name: Manual Spreading / Broadcasting
manual_spread.description: Evenly scattering granular fertilizer over the field surface
manual_spread.when_to_use: For organic manures (FYM, compost) or granular fertilizers over large areas

top_dressing.name: Top Dressing
top_dressing.description: Applying fertilizer near the base of growing plants during crop season
top_dressing.when_to_use: During vegetative or active growth stages — apply near plant base and irrigate

soil_incorporation.name: Soil Incorporation
soil_incorporation.description: Mixing organic manure or fertilizer deeply into the soil
soil_incorporation.when_to_use: For slow-release organic fertilizers — work into soil 2-4 weeks before planting

foliar_spray.name: Foliar Spray
foliar_spray.description: Spraying diluted liquid fertilizer directly on leaves for quick absorption
foliar_spray.when_to_use: For micronutrient deficiencies, critical growth stages, or when soil application is insufficient

fertigation.name: Fertigation
fertigation.description: Injecting water-soluble fertilizer through drip or sprinkler irrigation systems
fertigation.when_to_use: For farms with drip/sprinkler — most efficient method, reduces wastage

garden_hoe.name: Garden Hoe / Khurpi
garden_hoe.description: Hand tool for mixing fertilizer into topsoil in small plots

cultivator.name: Cultivator
cultivator.description: Tractor-drawn or manual cultivator to incorporate fertilizer into soil

seed_drill.name: Seed-cum-Fertilizer Drill
seed_drill.description: Places seed and fertilizer simultaneously in furrows

broadcast_spreader.name: Hand Broadcast Spreader
broadcast_spreader.description: Crank-operated spreader for even distribution of granular fertilizer

fertilizer_basket.name: Fertilizer Basket / Tokri
fertilizer_basket.description: Traditional woven basket for manual scattering of FYM, compost, or granules

wheelbarrow.name: Wheelbarrow
wheelbarrow.description: For transporting and dumping organic manure across the field

hand_duster.name: Hand Fertilizer Duster
hand_duster.description: Small applicator for placing granular fertilizer near plant rows

khurpi.name: Khurpi / Hand Weeder
khurpi.description: Used to make shallow furrows near plants, place fertilizer, and cover

ring_applicator.name: Ring Applicator
ring_applicator.description: Circular applicator for placing fertilizer in a ring around tree crops

spade.name: Spade / Phawda
spade.description: For digging in manure and compost into garden beds

rotavator.name: Rotavator / Rotary Tiller
rotavator.description: Power tiller attachment that mixes manure uniformly into topsoil

plough.name: Plough (MB / Desi)
plough.description: Traditional or mould-board plough for turning soil with organic matter

knapsack_sprayer.name: Knapsack Sprayer (16L)
knapsack_sprayer.description: Manual pump sprayer worn on back — most common for small-medium farms

battery_sprayer.name: Battery-Operated Sprayer
battery_sprayer.description: Electric pump sprayer for consistent pressure — reduces manual effort

measuring_cup.name: Measuring Cup / Beaker
measuring_cup.description: For precise dilution of concentrated liquid fertilizers

venturi_injector.name: Venturi Fertilizer Injector
venturi_injector.description: Low-cost device that uses water pressure to suck fertilizer solution into drip lines

mixing_tank.name: Fertilizer Mixing Tank
mixing_tank.description: Tank for dissolving and mixing water-soluble fertilizer before injection

dosing_pump.name: Fertigation Dosing Pump
dosing_pump.description: Electric or hydraulic pump for precise fertilizer injection into irrigation

benefits.rich_in_micronutrients_and_growth_hormon: Rich in micronutrients and growth hormones

notes.best_applied_23_weeks_before_sowing_mix_: Best applied 2-3 weeks before sowing. Mix well into topsoil.
notes.can_be_applied_as_basal_dose_or_topdress: Can be applied as basal dose or top-dressing. Avoid direct sunlight on stored vermicompost.
notes.apply_at_sowing_time_acts_as_nematicide_: Apply at sowing time. Acts as nematicide and insect repellent.
notes.works_best_in_acidic_to_neutral_soils_ph: Works best in acidic to neutral soils (pH < 7). Not effective in alkaline soils.
notes.dilute_as_per_instructions_best_as_folia: Dilute as per instructions. Best as foliar spray during active growth.
notes.ensure_compost_is_fully_decomposed_befor: Ensure compost is fully decomposed before application.
notes.may_attract_animals_mix_into_soil_well: May attract animals. Mix into soil well.
notes.most_effective_in_acidic_soils_ph__65_ve: Most effective in acidic soils (pH < 6.5). Very slow release.
notes.avoid_on_alkaline_soils_do_not_mix_with_: Avoid on alkaline soils. Do not mix with nitrogen fertilizers.
notes.incorporate_into_soil_34_weeks_before_so: Incorporate into soil 3-4 weeks before sowing main crop.
notes.apply_1520_days_before_sowing_for_best_r: Apply 15-20 days before sowing for best results.
notes.dilute_3_for_foliar_spray_apply_early_mo: Dilute 3% for foliar spray. Apply early morning or evening.
notes.apply_in_split_doses_avoid_flooding_imme: Apply in split doses. Avoid flooding immediately after application.
notes.best_applied_at_sowing_as_basal_dose: Best applied at sowing as basal dose.
notes.apply_at_sowing_or_during_tuberfruit_for: Apply at sowing or during tuber/fruit formation.
notes.ideal_for_crops_with_high_p_and_k_demand: Ideal for crops with high P and K demand.
notes.preferred_over_mop_for_chloridesensitive: Preferred over MOP for chloride-sensitive crops (potato, tomato, fruits).
notes.good_for_acidic_soils_and_calciumloving_: Good for acidic soils and calcium-loving crops.
notes.common_deficiency_in_indian_soils_apply_: Common deficiency in Indian soils. Apply 25 kg/ha to soil or 0.5% foliar spray.
notes.critical_for_oilseeds_pulses_and_vegetab: Critical for oilseeds, pulses, and vegetables. Do not over-apply — boron toxicity is possible.
notes.apply_23_weeks_before_sowing_raises_ph_b: Apply 2-3 weeks before sowing. Raises pH by 0.5-1.0 unit per 2000 kg/ha.
notes.also_supplies_magnesium_preferred_for_mg: Also supplies magnesium. Preferred for Mg-deficient soils.
notes.for_alkalinesodic_soils_also_improves_so: For alkaline/sodic soils. Also improves soil structure.
notes.slowacting_apply_well_in_advance_microbe: Slow-acting. Apply well in advance. Microbes convert S to sulfuric acid.

rainfall_reasons.dry_paddy__nutrients_not_mobilized_incre: Dry paddy — nutrients not mobilized, increase dose
